name: TrueWood Lite Natural Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real natural oak veneer on three sides, stapled to 5 mm black acoustic felt. The 118 in panel is 11.81 in wide installed and 0.39 in thick.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec dimensions override photo estimates: 8 slats with 27 mm faces and 10.5 mm gaps on a 37.5 mm pitch, 5 mm slats on 5 mm felt; the tile covers 300 x 600 mm. Oak tones are sampled from the main listing photo and black felt follows that selected product/photo, despite the sheet listing oatmeal felt for Natural Oak.
